aboutGame.title: What is Wyldheart?
paragraphs: Wyldheart is a cooperative fantasy action RPG from Wayfinder Studios, published in partnership with Curve Games. It is set in a rustic mythic world steeped in Fey folklore, and its hook is refreshingly unheroic: you are not the chosen one. You begin as a humble peasant tossed into a dungeon and tasked with recovering one of the ancient Relics of Caerwyn to protect your town.

Wyldheart throws out fixed classes. You build a hero from three ancestries, 19 roleplaying backgrounds, and 50+ skills spread across five classless trees, then swap between melee weapons, ranged weapons, spells, and thrown concoctions mid-fight. Play solo or with up to four players through drop-in co-op with cloud-shared saves, and try the limited demo in the Whisperwood region while the full release date stays to be announced.

faq.title: Wyldheart FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Wyldheart, from ancestries and skill trees to co-op and demo availability.

items.question: What is Wyldheart?
items.answer: Wyldheart is a cooperative fantasy action RPG from Wayfinder Studios, published in partnership with Curve Games. It is set in a mythic world steeped in Fey folklore, and you start as a humble peasant sent into a dungeon to recover one of the ancient Relics of Caerwyn rather than as a chosen hero.

items.question: Does Wyldheart have classes?
items.answer: No. Wyldheart uses fully flexible classless skill trees, so you spread 50+ skills across Adventuring, Survival, Dungeoneering, Weaponry, and Magic instead of locking into a job at character creation.

items.question: Can you play Wyldheart in co-op?
items.answer: Yes. Wyldheart supports solo play and online co-op for up to four players, with drop-in and drop-out sessions, cloud-shared saves, group XP, and difficulty that scales with party size.

items.question: Is there a Wyldheart demo I can play now?
items.answer: Yes, a limited Wyldheart demo is available. It covers the Whisperwood region, its dungeons, and destructible mushrooms, but save progress is not confirmed to carry over into the full release.

items.question: When does Wyldheart release?
items.answer: A Wyldheart release date has not been announced. The closed beta opened on May 15, 2026 for backers, Early Access is planned for PC before the end of 2026, and the 1.0 launch is targeted for 2027.

items.question: How long is a Wyldheart campaign?
items.answer: Wyldheart campaigns run roughly 10 hours of story plus about 15 hours of optional content, which the developers designed so a group of four can realistically reach the credits together.
